name: Attendance Alert
description: Notify parent when learner is absent
message_body: Dear {guardian_name}, your child {learner_name} was marked absent today ({date}). Please contact the school if you have any concerns.

name: Fee Reminder
message_body: Dear {guardian_name}, this is a reminder that school fees for {learner_name} ({class_name}) are due. Please make payment at your earliest convenience.

name: Report Card Ready
description: Notify when report card is available
message_body: Dear {guardian_name}, the {term} report card for {learner_name} is now available. Please visit the school to collect it or check the parent portal.

name: Event Reminder
message_body: Dear {guardian_name}, reminder: {event_name} is scheduled for {event_date}. We look forward to seeing you!
